standalone_distributions.description: Filtered view of capabilities whose distribution.standalone is true; not a second semantic inventory.

mirror_contract.rule: Moon Source is the only semantic and versioning authority. LUAHELENA mirrors current canonical capability bodies and exposes standalone distributions as convenience delivery surfaces.
update_procedure: Update the canonical capability body in Moon Source first.
Run scripts/validate_public_capabilities.py and the preserved link, licensing, stamp and title/version checks.
Copy exact canonical UTF-8 bytes to the mapped LUAHELENA mirror path on a branch.
Keep website open links pointed at canonical Moon Source bodies and keep download links pointed at standalone delivery surfaces.
Run scripts/check_mirror_sync.py against the remote mirror or a local LUAHELENA checkout.
Open and review a website pull request; merge only after SHA-256 equality and facade review.
mirror_contract.current_rebase_note: The schema 2.0 registry contains one record per public capability. Architectural role and distribution role are independent; portable is a supported standalone distribution profile, not a competing semantic class. Connected Sources is the structural crown jewel at docs/CONNECTED_SOURCES.md and remains standalone-capable at 1.1-public. The six standalone distributions retain self-onboarding canonical bodies and exact package/mirror byte contracts. No method version bump is earned by this structural registry rebase.
